start_consultation.title: Start consultation with {name}?
start_consultation.body: Ticket {number} will show as "with the doctor" on the waiting-room screen and the next visitor present becomes Ready.

finish_consultation.title: Finish {name}'s consultation?
finish_consultation.body: The next visitor will not be started automatically. You will confirm it separately. Expected times are recalculated for everyone.

mark_absent.title: Mark {name} as absent?
mark_absent.body: The next visitor present becomes Ready. If {name} hasn't returned after {lateAfter} more finished consultations, she moves to the end of the queue as Late.

mark_late.title: Move {name} to the end of the queue?
mark_late.body: Their status becomes Late and everyone's expected time is recalculated.

cancel.title: Cancel {name}'s visit?
cancel.body: They are removed from today's queue and their appointment is cancelled. This cannot be undone from the queue.

duration.title: Consultation duration
duration.body: {name} · expected times update for everyone after her.

toast.mark_late: {name} moved to the end of the queue

secretaries.doctorOnly: Only the doctor can manage staff accounts
secretaries.emptyBody: Add one so reception can register walk-ins and manage the queue.

create.doneBody: Share the email and password with them privately.

create.body: They sign in on the staff page and can manage visitors, appointments and the queue, but not settings or staff.

actions.pwChangedBody: Share the new password with {name} privately.
